The '''Hidakai Pool''' was an ancient [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] running through [[Herglic Space/Legends|Herglic Space]]. Development of the route began around [[13,000 BBY]] during the [[Kymoodon Era]], after the [[Herglic Trade Empire]] joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> The route ran from [[Daupherm/Legends|Daupherm]] via [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] and [[Giju/Legends|Giju]] to [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]], where it joined the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="Warfare" />

After [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]], the Hidakai Pool coreward of [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] became a spur of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] after [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]], [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] mapped and established the Rimma.<ref name="TEA" />
